On Android 12 and later, the caller number is only delivered to apps that hold call log permission; without it the caller name is never announced even if saved in your contacts, and only what the phone notification shows is spoken. This app is made for blind and low-vision users: granting the log lets it announce the caller by voice before answering, so a blind user knows who is calling before lifting the phone. The permission is used for announcing the name only; nothing else is read.

Some manufacturers pause background voice announcements to save battery. Grant Lord TTS an exemption from battery optimization and open the app settings to confirm background announcements keep working.
Xiaomi/Redmi/POCO device: Lord TTS needs a battery optimization exemption and "Autostart" enabled under Mi security management to keep background voice announcements alive.
Huawei/Honor device: enable the battery exemption and "Auto-launch" under System Manager (Apps > Special) so background voice announcements keep working.
Oppo/OnePlus/realme device: open the battery exemption and allow Lord TTS under "Startup management" in the security center to keep background announcements alive.
Vivo device: enable the battery exemption and "Auto start" under the permission manager so background voice announcements keep working.
Samsung device: enable the battery exemption, open the app settings, and keep Lord TTS out of "Sleeping apps" so background voice announcements keep working.

Version %1$s - Dialpad, Keyboard, and Engine Switching: Direct call dispatching via unified CallPlacer with dual-SIM account resolution and safe fallback, CommitGate input debounce across lift-to-type and double-tap with TalkBack hover speech suppression, dedicated Arabic hamzas keyboard row and configurable button sizes for keyboard and dialpad, strict selector-based "Read More" expansion, system-wide TTS engine switching via WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS with built-in ADB guide activity, and atomic batch persistence for auto-convert language preferences - Unify voice preview with event announcement speech: Preview voice now strictly mirrors natural event speech across all categories (caller, battery, time, notifications, SMS) by matching AudioAttributes, stream mode routing, category audio effects, volume/speech boosts, custom pronunciation dictionary, and Arabic speech normalization - Engine switching improvements and Acapella support: Next-engine switcher immediately applies the new engine\'s voice upon switching, preserves default voice when returning to Lord TTS, ensures official Acapella TTS Voices app compatibility on Android 16 and 17, and hardens Vocalizer 2 category voice persistence - In-call screen, proximity sensor, and audio fixes: Automatically turn off screen and disable touches near ear via PROXIMITY_SCREEN_OFF_WAKE_LOCK to prevent accidental mic mute or speaker toggle by cheek contact, permanently hide incoming answer and reject actions during active calls via direct CallListener, and fix proximity sensor auto-speaker routing to reliably switch between earpiece and speaker without freezing - Fix default dialer role request and swipe gesture handling: Launch default dialer role request via ActivityResultLauncher to ensure the system chooser dialog displays reliably without being immediately dismissed, and fully decouple two-finger swipe/scroll gestures in TalkBack across the keyboard and dialpad by delegating raw touches to the system and preventing accidental key/digit commits during touch exploration and multi-finger touch - Accessible Speed Dial (slots 1 to 10,000): Dedicated memory for quick calling with caller name and number announcement on touch or "Empty", dual SIM calling dialog (SIM 1 / SIM 2), slot assignment and deletion remaining within speed dial list, and app drawer icon shortcut toggle in app tools and phone settings - Dual SIM support in Lord Phone: Side-by-side call buttons for SIM 1 and SIM 2 with automatic carrier name detection - Always show number row option in Accessible Keyboard: Option to pin a permanent number row (1-0) above letters in normal text mode for faster typing - Enhanced touch exploration for Lord Phone and Keyboard: Lift-to-type activation to prevent unintended input upon touch, along with improved accuracy for "Read More" expansion - Lord TTS Accessible Phone & Call Recording: Fully accessible dialer and call history with automatic or on-demand call recording at maximum volume, and consolidated phone and keyboard shortcuts under App Tools - Previous engine switching: Backward engine toggle support via Quick Actions menu, Quick Settings tile, and system shortcuts - Fix keyboard TalkBack compatibility: Full touch exploration via ExploreByTouchHelper and hover event dispatching, removal of two-finger swipe interference, live test area responsiveness, and voice typing fix by eliminating TTS speech during recording, adding direct microphone permission request, haptic guidance, and comprehensive error handling - Direct entry point for accessible keyboard customization and settings added under app settings and tools menu - Lord TTS Accessible Keyboard for blind and visually impaired users: Supports Blind mode (audio/haptic focused) and Low Vision mode (high contrast), Lift-to-Type or Double-Tap activation, optional character re-announcement, phonetic letter hints, quick Arabic diacritics bar, integrated clipboard toolbar (copy, paste, cut, select all), and voice typing without auto-correct or spellcheck - Active Lord TTS engine switching: Link the next engine across all active languages and default category for screen reading with immediate auto-convert update, plus default engine fallback in speech routing and SystemVoiceProvider - Quick Lord TTS engine switching: a standalone next-engine tile, Accessibility menu action, and long-press shortcut, plus immediate pronunciation-dictionary synchronization between the settings and engine processes - Embedded Vocalizer voices support for all event categories (time, battery, caller, notifications): Direct PCM synthesis and streaming playback via AudioTrack and EmbeddedProviders.vocalizer in AnnouncementSpeaker with category volume boosts, audio attributes routing, and clean interruption, plus fixing speech resolution precedence in SpeechPlanner to prevent language default from overriding category-specific voice and engine - Re-engineered "Read More" expansion for WhatsApp and messaging apps: Multi-strategy search targeting sibling nodes and direct actions while stripping TalkBack role, timestamp, and message status suffixes during prefix matching, with "Expand Read More" added to volume key shortcuts and Quick Menu - Vocalizer voice generation and SynthesisCallback lifecycle fix: Resolve catalog and language IDs in VocalizerHostSession, fallback defaults to Laila/Samantha, enforce native engine thread affinity for all JNI calls, chunk MonitoredSynthesisCallback buffers to maxBufferSize with atomic start/done/error lifecycles, disable fdsan before native library load, and manage audio focus in previews - Real-time update download progress dialog (R42-10): Non-dismissible progress dialog with percentage and downloaded MBs, live accessibility announcements every 10%%, hide button to continue in background with visible notification, cancel button to purge download and file, and auto-resume upon returning to screen - Count-based caller repetition: Replaced time-window scheduling with a count-based loop that awaits each speech completion before the interval to prevent overlapping, with a 90-second ringing safety cap, independent repeat count for call waiting, and adaptive wake lock capped at 120 seconds - Event Loudness Policy (EventLoudnessPolicy): Force maximum volume for caller, time, battery, and SMS with silent and DND bypass via alarm stream, safe volume cap for wired and Bluetooth headsets, and automatic volume restore - PCM Loudness Stage and Soft Limiter (LoudnessStage): Boost PCM audio gain up to +6 dB for embedded engines during event announcements with a soft limiter to prevent clipping - Unified Speech Planner for Numbers and Emojis (SpeechPlanner): Language family matching to keep same-family numbers and Arabic text in a single consistent voice, unified emoji category support across screen reader and announcements, with custom pronunciation dictionary priority - Quick actions: an overlay above apps that announces the implemented screen-service actions (read screen, read clipboard, repeat last, spell last, where am I, pause, continuous reading, image reading) - Continuous reading: announces the screen page by page, scrolling content automatically to the end; stops on app change, screen off, or a call - Image reading (OCR): recognizes and reads the focused element text via Tesseract, downloading language data on first use (requires Android 11+) - Two new settings switches to enable continuous reading and image reading - Volume-key shortcut customization screen: gesture list (long/double/triple/both-hold) with per-gesture action choice and an instant test button - Redesigned volume-key shortcuts: a gesture is consumed only after it is completed, so volume never changes before the shortcut fires; bindings are configurable and persisted - Throttled window-content-change events (80 ms) to reduce main-thread load - Removed dead code in the accessibility service - Embedded engines & live storage inventory: Unified engine IDs across client and host endpoints, accurate live inventory tracking, and engine data cleanup - Fixed Sherpa and Piper search paths: Corrected model discovery, automatic storage migration, and instant cache invalidation upon download - Visible unavailable engines: Disabled engine rows with clear failure reasons and status badges across selection lists - Enhanced engine details dialog: Background auto-initialization for completed voices and detailed diagnostic logs - Unified voice preview: Explicit failure messages and accurate model directory resolution for Sherpa models - Comprehensive unit test suite covering host sessions, live storage inventory, status registry, and model discovery - Screen and Accessibility Services: Automatic expansion of truncated messages, live chat reading, clipboard reading, typing echo, emergency shortcut, pause duration picker, and app whitelist policy - Audio DSP Processing Chain: 5-band parametric equalizer, dynamic range compressor, spatial panner, reverb, earcon generator, and dedicated audio routing - Category Resolution and Engine Safety (CategoryResolver): Prevention of silent default engine fallback, automatic Google TTS retry, and voice readiness handling - Comprehensive diagnostic logging at first speech: Added detailed log for bound engine, voices count, voiceId, and locale in AnnouncementSpeaker - Added text processing stage controls (time, currency, units, symbols, phone, Arabic normalization) and fixed blank caller number guard - Fix changelog crash: escape literal %% signs in changelog strings (%%) to prevent UnknownFormatConversionException when opening changelog dialog - Concurrency cap and deferred engine discovery: Capped concurrent engine probes to max 3 with immediate shutdown per probe, and deferred catalog discovery until the engine section is opened instead of running on home view - Call waiting caller announcement routed to earpiece: On Android 12+ (API 31+) via setCommunicationDevice(TYPE_BUILTIN_EARPIECE) and USAGE_VOICE_COMMUNICATION without raising STREAM_VOICE_CALL, with single-announcement guarantee - Progressive speedup for long texts: New setting (long_text_speedup_enabled) disabled by default, gradually increases rate up to +15%% after 300 characters without affecting screen readers, with tests for 299/300/301 boundaries - Added caller_ar and caller_en categories to Diagnostics Info (buildDiagnosticsInfo) with resolved engine and voice origin (explicit, inherited, or none) - Fixed update checker: GitHub tag `vN` in 0.x phase treated as `0.N.0` — no false update when equal (v1.6.29 = 1.6.29) - Cleaned changelog: removed internal references ("manager decision"), changelog is now public-facing - Exported receiver guard uses exact action equality (not startsWith) - API 29 guard in Call Screening Service now testable - New call-route tests (SpeechRouteDecisionTest) - Fixed Korean character corruption in TimeDuringCallsVolumeTest comment - Documented intentional attribute/stream divergence in AnnouncementSpeaker - Added 9 guard test files for governing contracts - The hourly chime now follows the spoken volume - The caller name no longer repeats over your call after you answer - Fixed an app crash when opening any file - The dictionary is now actually applied while speaking - The delete and import dictionary options are now visible - A saved caller is now spoken by name instead of number - A call you place is no longer announced back to you as incoming - Stuck TTS engines no longer freeze opening the settings - Opening the settings is faster - Fixed Google Meet caller announcements - Caller name is spoken sooner - Caller identity is checked every 50ms instead of 300ms - The caller preview now sounds exactly like the real announcement - The dictionary now matches with no boundaries at all - The dictionary now applies to English as well - A broken import now fails completely - Dictionary import accepts JSON files only - Import limits: 200000 entries and 8000 characters per key and value - The dictionary export file is now named LOR_dictionary.json - The phrase Incoming call from is removed for good - Fixed incoming call from being spoken to the caller themselves - Lower the phone ringtone while the caller is announced - A separate volume level during calls - Caller announcement is now always as loud as battery and clock announcements - Speak a phrase you choose before the caller name and one after it - Caller announcement repeat now goes from once up to ten times - The dictionary is open with no length ceiling - Voice-key shortcut bindings: gestures (long/double/triple/both) with a live test button - Quick accessibility menu and accessibility button gate - Where am I: announces the focused element role and screen location - Repeat and spell with a rolling speech history (20 entries) - Chat summary: reads new-chat overview (sender names and counts) with throttling - Spoken URL shortening with an independent toggle - Call key actions: answer or reject with a volume key while ringing (swappable) - Audio route and Bluetooth device announcements on Android 12+ - Contact voices: a per-contact voice applied to their calls and messages - App profiles and automatic per-app voice switching - Features and gestures guide button - Full voice editor for contacts and app profiles: engine, voice, speed, pitch and volume with preview - 32-bit device support: ship armeabi-v7a alongside arm64-v8a (embedded Vocalizer, system engine, OCR, and all features work across both 32-bit and 64-bit)
